description: A measure of the cost of overnight general collateral funding in Canadian dollars using Government of Canada treasury bills and bonds as collateral for repurchase transactions (repos).

licence.name: Bank of Canada Terms of Use
licence.conditions: Free to use, copy and distribute. Attribute the Bank of Canada as the source and indicate any changes. Bank of Canada exchange rates are for statistical and analytical purposes only, not for executing trades.

access: Public. Free, no account or API key required. The Bank's terms prohibit circumventing its request limits.
retrieval_method: Bank of Canada Valet REST API: observations/{series}/json returns the full history of the requested series together with each series' label, description, unit and frequency. The response is stored unchanged as the raw file.
frequency_basis: declared by Bank of Canada (Business daily)
update_frequency: business daily; published 09:00-11:00 ET for the previous business day
revision_policy: Can be republished the same day before the Bank's operational cut-off; not changed afterwards

reproducibility_rating.basis: 2 retrievals produced the same raw data (sha256:8f3dd5c99083...), on 2026-10-24

quality_notes: 7294 rows in raw file; 7294 rows in processed file (Canada). Missing values: 0 of 7294 observations have no value (0.0%): none. Validation passed.
known_limitations: The current trimmed volume-weighted median method applies from 2020-06-15; earlier values use the previous methodology. Not published on market holidays
